Precompute coordinate-dependent spatial constants for Moran's I.

precomp_moran.Rd

Since W, S1, S2, and EI depend solely on the spatial coordinates (c1, c2) and not on the residual vector x, precomputing them once per area avoids redundant work across EM iterations while preserving exact output. Exploits symmetry of Euclidean distances (j > i) to halve distance evaluations.

Usage

precomp_moran(c1, c2)

Arguments

c1

x-coordinates.

c2

y-coordinates.

Value

NumericVector of length 4: c(W, S1, S2, ei).

Author

Florica J Constantine, florica AT berkeley.edu
